title: Bánk bán and the Stage as Political Forum
grammar: Negative purpose clauses with nehogy + subjunctive
goal: I can say why the censors held back Katona József's Bánk bán.
I can use nehogy + subjunctive for a precaution (Vigyáztak, nehogy ...).
I can talk about the play and the stage in short sentences.
